review.summary: Implements daily per-prefix ticket codes with validated per-queue prefix maps, single-clock issuance, factory day alignment, migration with backfill and unique swap, plus docs and thorough Pest coverage. Overall approve with nits: the only gap is missing unauthorized-call coverage for the new UpdateQueue parameter.
